correctness.rationale: For n>=2r+1 every edge has a unique short clockwise arc. The proof gives inducedness exactly by cyclic gaps >=r+1 and maximality exactly by also bounding all gaps <=2r+2; inclusion of any further edge is equivalent to two adjacent eligible vertices in a gap of length >=2r+3. Rooted-block bijection justifies n/k, while contiguous block degrees prove exact support and divisibility multiplicities. Standalone graph-level tests agree in 44 cases (116874 candidate edge subsets), and 888 arithmetic cases corroborate integrality/support, but infinite quantification rests only on the proof.

value.rationale: The two-parameter family C_n^r is canonical and a known scalar maximum (Romeo) leaves a genuine distributional gap. The complete labeled all-solution and minimal/maximal-solution polynomials, exact minimum maximal induced-matching size ceil(n/(3r+2)), no-hole support, and rigid multiplicities at two divisibility extremes are mathematically distinct, informative and likely reusable for enumeration and extremal comparison. The result does not depend on an unsupported general downstream theorem.
